title: Summer Palace · Duobao Glazed Pagoda

buildingCutout.basis: Only occupied footprints of the documented buildings are replaced.

note: The independent octagonal tower follows the lone matching mapped footprint near the historic photograph location. Three decorated drum levels and seven glazed eaves follow exterior photographs. Glazed motifs and their colors are simplified. The demolished Huacheng Pavilion is omitted. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.
